message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes based on facts. The case: Wang Mou defrauded Hong Moumou by claiming to purchase house, car garage, handling house registration, etc., obtaining 115,000 RMB. That's fraud/诈骗. Also he later filed false report claiming victim defrauded him 640,000 and had friend give false testimony to make victim criminally liable. That's false reporting and making false statements, possibly "伪证罪" (giving false testimony) or "诬告陷害罪" (false accusation). In Chinese criminal law, making false accusations to police is "诬告陷害罪". Also filing false report is "虚假报警罪"? Actually "诬告陷害罪" is to falsely accuse someone of a crime. So Wang's act of filing false report and having friend give false testimony to cause victim to be prosecuted is "诬告陷害罪". Also the original fraud is "诈骗罪". So answer likely: 诈骗;诬告陷害. In examples they separate with semicolon. So final answer: [罪名]诈骗;诬告陷害<eoa>.
